messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH-PRIORITY alert fired for inference-gateway-prod-eu-west1 — 5xx error-rate spike >20% (2m). Auto-page to oncall. Incident ID: INC-2026-713. Links: https://pd.redwood/INC-2026-713, runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-713 assigned to rotation: alex. Pager: https://pd.redwood/accept/INC-2026-713 :rotating_light:

Alex Chen: acked. I'm on it. Quick question — any recent deploys to gateway?

Diego Rivera: Diego Rivera: pushed a routing tweak to gateway-config 6m ago (small nginx weight change). Wanted to monitor, not a full rollout. Noticed a rollback window set to 15m but didn't trigger.

Alex Chen: Alex Chen: checking deploy history + logs now. Running fast checks:
```bash
# last 5m 5xx counts
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/query?m=5xx_count&svc=inference-gateway&env=prod&region=eu-west1"
```

Morgan (SRE): Morgan (SRE): seeing KV cache node evictions on kv-cache-eu-west1 around the same time — eviction spikes and increased latency. Miss rate up from 5% -> 42%. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/kv-evict

Jae Kim: Jae Kim: I can trigger an emergency scale of the kv-cache cluster and warm new nodes. Kicking that now.

incident-bot: Auto-scaling request submitted: +2 kv-cache nodes for eu-west1. Warmup in progress.

Priya Sharma: Priya Sharma: Customer Impact — Support tickets flagging timeouts for generation endpoints (3 customers, high-traffic). Status page draft? We should push interim status: partial degradation for eu-west1.

Alex Chen: Alex Chen: agreed. Posting status update now and adding incident note. Also enabling fallback routing to compatible smaller model variant (variant-B) to reduce per-request memory usage while we stabilize.

Diego Rivera: Diego Rivera: rolling back my routing tweak now (manual rollback) — will confirm when live.

Alex Chen: Alex Chen: rollback confirmed in prod at commit sha abc123. 5xx trending down but still noisy. Running a quick sampling of logs reveals repeated "kv_get timeout" and high retry attempts from gateway to cache.

incident-bot: Automated mitigation: fallback model variant enabled for inference-gateway-prod-eu-west1. Telemetry: 5xx rate dropped from 24% -> 10% within 1m.

Jae Kim: Jae Kim: kv-cache scale completed and nodes passed health checks. Evictions dropping.

Alex Chen: Alex Chen: I'm going to disable aggressive retry logic for gateway (temporary) to avoid retry amplification. Patch applied via feature-flag.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-713 acknowledged by Alex Chen. Escalations suppressed.

Priya Sharma: Priya Sharma: I'll take night watch. Alex — can you add a short handoff note with actions taken + next steps? I'll own monitoring and customer comms for the next 30m.

Alex Chen: Alex Chen: handoff note added to incident ticket: actions = rollback routing tweak, scaled kv-cache +2, enabled fallback model variant, disabled aggressive retries. Next steps = postmortem + root-cause analysis on cache eviction cause, consider capacity buffer. Assigning postmortem owner: Alex.

Morgan (SRE): Morgan (SRE): leaving a quick snippet from logs for RCA:
```
[2026-02-18T21:05:12Z] kv-cache-eu-1 eviction triggered: exceed-lru-threshold (mem pressure), candidate_count=12
[2026-02-18T21:05:13Z] gateway->kv timeout after 1200ms, retry=3
```

Priya Sharma: Priya Sharma: accepted handoff. I'll monitor for 30m and update status page if regressions. If we see >5% 5xx again, I'll page the rotation.

Alex Chen: Alex Chen: thanks team. tagging followups: infra to investigate root cause of sudden mem pressure (possible regressions in client-side caching), product/devex to evaluate safe lower-retry defaults.

incident-bot: Mitigation in progress. Current 5xx = 0.9% (last 1m). Incident remains open for postmortem tracking.

pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-713 notes updated. Next update planned in 30m or on status change.

Priya Sharma: Priya Sharma: confirming handoff and note logged. I'll escalate immediately if noise resurfaces. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Alex Chen: closing my active involvement — leaving Priya as oncall lead. Good work everyone.

incident-bot: End of thread snapshot: mitigation applied, customer impact limited to partial degradation for ~8 minutes. Postmortem owner: Alex Chen. Runbook reference: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx.
